backup.production_rule: D-352 (s100): a cleaner can always report "No meter photo was taken"; never two neighbouring STAYS (calendar order, not filing order) without a photo unless BOTH hold an admin exception (meter_skip_exceptions). A reading with no photo is flagged estimate_pending: never a neighbour or history sample. When the next confirmed stay has a vision-ok, unflagged reading, the typed numbers are kept if A <= p1 <= .. <= pn <= B (flag typed_accepted), else every pending reading in the gap gets A + (B - A) * cumulative nights / total nights, the next stay included (electric 2 dp, water 3 dp, flag estimated). Adds table meter_skip_exceptions (RLS on, no policy, service_role only), can_skip_meter_photos_v2(uuid,date) (authenticated + service_role), report_no_meter_photo_v1(uuid,text) (authenticated; submitter or admin), meter_no_photo_notice_v1(uuid) and meter_settle_estimates_v1(uuid) (service_role only), the internal s_meter_skip_check_v1 and s_meter_nights_v1 (no grants), and the pg_cron job meter-settle-estimates every 30 minutes. Replaces ONLY review_meter_reading_v1 (20260914200000 body md5 1b23dc6085db7eeee408fe63bc0f50be guarded, 55000 on mismatch) to whitelist estimate_pending, typed_accepted, estimated. Grants restated for every function (ML-21). can_skip_meter_photos (v1) is not touched.
backup.notes: Phase expand: one table, six functions added, one body replaced, one cron job. No column added; meter_readings.meter_flag has no CHECK and gets none. Old Staff app + new SQL is safe (v1 untouched). Order: SQL, then the data step supabase/sql/2026-10-29-s100-exceptions.sql (Lloyd block: exceptions for 2026-10-19 and 2026-10-21, Shaneen session declared skipped and her reading estimate_pending, task opened; idempotent), then deploy submit-cleaning and EVERY function that bundles _shared/meter-order.ts, then push Cascade-Staff. The data step is NOT part of the migration. The settle job needs no deploy: it is plain SQL under pg_cron.
